email.subject: Mane Street Works: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I checked Mane Street Works' site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it isn't mobile-friendly, so most phone visitors struggle to even browse it, and there's no click-to-call button, so people searching on their phones can't tap to ring you directly. On top of that, there's no online booking and the footer still has outdated info.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
